display.purpose: The hero name only; the 404 title uses the same treatment one step down.

statement.purpose: Standalone large lines: the scroll-lit statement, the quote, the swatch line.

title.purpose: Hairline list names and chart titles.

lead.purpose: The sentence under a headline, 28 to 38ch, usually secondary colour.

label.purpose: Nav links, chart axis and annotations, wave labels, swatch names. Sentence case.

fine.purpose: Photo credits and footer, secondary colour.

shadows.name: icon-edge
shadows.purpose: Hairline ring so a dark app icon reads on black.

shadows.name: knockout-ring
shadows.purpose: Separates the trace finish dot from gridlines.

shadows.name: nav-material
shadows.value: backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px); background: rgb(251 251 253 / 0.72) | dark: rgb(22 22 23 / 0.8)
shadows.purpose: Translucent global nav; the only material effect in the system.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances (hero rise, 1100ms, 120ms stagger) and pill press (200ms).

motion.name: ease-colour
motion.purpose: Hover colour changes (200ms) and nav light/dark cross-fade (300ms).

motion.name: scroll-linear
motion.value: linear, animation-fill-mode: both, on view() or a named view-timeline
motion.purpose: All scroll-driven animation: statement word-lighting, photo open, pinned trace draw, wave draw.

motion.name: scroll-longhands
motion.value: animation-name / animation-timing-function / animation-fill-mode / animation-timeline / animation-range as separate declarations
motion.purpose: Required. The build's CSS minifier folds animation-timeline into the animation shorthand and Chrome then drops the whole declaration. Never use the shorthand for scroll-driven animation.

motion.name: scroll-gate
motion.purpose: Every scroll-linked animation sits inside both; keyframes are from-only so the resting state is the finished state.

motion.name: pin
motion.value: section height 240vh; sticky top 3rem; min-height calc(100vh - 3rem); animation-range contain 8% to contain 78%

motion.name: ambient-drift
motion.purpose: Hero gradient blobs; the only looping motion, gated on reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Hero band shortens; hairline list stacks.

breakpoints.name: chart
breakpoints.purpose: Trace thins axis labels, drops optional annotations.

narrative.overview:
A personal page built the way Apple builds a product page, with Stripe's finish: one idea per section, big confident type, real media, and scroll moments that carry the story. Every section is a full-width band on one of three grounds (white, Apple grey, true black), with content on a 1080px column that images deliberately break: they bleed off a viewport edge or cross a section edge, and the copy alternates sides. Density is low on purpose. A section holds a headline, a lead, and at most one piece of media or one pair of actions.

Papaya is the only colour that isn't a neutral. It appears as the pill button, the text links, the drawn lines (the Sochi trace, the MS wave), the hero's drifting gradient band, and the full-bleed swatch band. Everything else is ink on paper or paper on black. Depth comes from the ground changing, not from shadows.

Motion is scroll-driven CSS. One-time reveals bring text, the team tile and the speedmark in as they enter view. Scroll-driven CSS lights words, drifts the rain, draws lines and fills a reading-progress line. Reduced motion and browsers without `animation-timeline` get the finished state, never an empty one.
keyCharacteristics: Three section grounds: white, Apple grey, black. The nav follows them.
One accent, papaya, used for actions and drawn lines.
Mona Sans only, weights 500 to 700, with tight tracking on display sizes.
Centred, single-column sections with generous vertical padding.
Real photographs in 28px-rounded frames or full-bleed bands, always credited.
Scroll-driven CSS motion whose resting state is the finished state.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: Papaya is the only accent. It marks things you can act on, and lines that tell the story. Nothing decorative is papaya except the hero band and the swatch band, and each appears once.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every section sits on #ffffff, #f5f5f7 or #000000. Ground changes are the section breaks; no borders, cards or tinted panels stand in for them. The one exception is a photo band, where the photograph is the ground.

rules.name: The Papaya-As-Text Rule
rules.body: Text in papaya uses #a94f00 on light grounds and #ff9a3d on black. Raw #ff8000 is for fills and strokes only.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Mona Sans only. Hierarchy comes from size, weight (500, 560, 600, 650, 700) and tracking, never from a second typeface.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: The bigger the type, the tighter the tracking: -0.04em at display, -0.035em at headline and statement, -0.025em at title, about -0.01em at body.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no letter-spaced small labels, and no small line above a headline. A headline introduces itself.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If something needs separating, change the ground, add a 1px hairline, or use a zero-offset ring.

dos: Do put every section on #ffffff, #f5f5f7 or #000000, and add the `.dark` class to black sections so the nav turns dark over them.
Do pair one papaya pill with one chevron text link in a centred action row.
Do use #a94f00 for papaya text on light grounds and #ff9a3d on black.
Do write scroll-driven animations as longhands inside `@supports (animation-timeline: view())` and `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, with the finished state as the default.

Do source photographs from Pixabay through `scripts/fetch-pixabay.mjs` (IDs in `scripts/pixabay.json`). Commit them to `src/assets/pixabay/`, serve them through Astro's `Picture` (avif and webp at 640, 960 and 1280 widths), and credit each one both under the image and in the footer from `credits.json`.
Do keep images at or below the 1280px the standard Pixabay key returns. Size frames and `sizes` attributes so a 1280px source is not stretched past it.
Do keep tap targets at 2.75rem or more, and give every drawn chart a prose equivalent for screen readers.
donts: Don't use drop shadows, cards or tinted panels. Separate with the ground, a 1px hairline or a zero-offset ring.
Don't add a second accent colour. Ribbon orange lives only in the swatch band.
Don't use raw #ff8000 for small text on white or grey.
Don't use the `animation` shorthand for a scroll-driven animation.
Don't hotlink Pixabay images or ship the API key. The key stays in `.env`.
Don't set labels in uppercase or tracked small caps, and don't put a small label line above a headline.
Don't repeat the hero gradient band or the swatch band. Each is used once.
Don't introduce a second typeface or an icon font. Icons are inline Lucide SVGs.
